image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a custom chrome alloy car wheel mounted on a bright yellow vehicle. The wheel features a multi-spoke design with polished metal spokes radiating from a central hub. The rim has a deep dish profile with visible bolt holes or decorative rivets around the inner lip. A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim. The background shows the yellow fender arch and dark shadows.
